text:
Spotify
I love spotifyyy so much but there are a couple of things I would like to be out into consideration, which include 

1. ADS 🌸
Ads are EVERYWHERE. Don’t get me wrong, some ads are good for discovering new songs and stuff, but mostly annoying. You can skip them whilst you are watching a podcast but not while listening to songs. Once, I had to listen to 6 ads in a row before I could listen to my music. They aren’t that bad that you want to delete the app, but..

2. Music videos. 🌸
How come I can’t watch music videos, but I can watch previews of the song and podcasts with videos? Doesn’t make sense.

3. Yearly wrap-up.🌺
This is my fav feature, but there should be a feature in This called; ‘Spotify soulmates’. This has been going around for a while on listeners album covers, so I thought I would include it. Every year, Spotify matches you with another listener who likes the same music, has the same taste as you and can possibly start to get to know each other. But this would be ai moderated or something and completely optional to talk to them. This would also include more diversity of listeners and draw in more people. 

4. Skips.🌞
On free, you only get 6 skips. It’s not that bad but.. it is. Imagine yourself at your beloved grandmas house, eating spaghetti, the homemade tomato sauce filling your stomach with sensations of “I need to eat this, I can’t resist!”, then imagine being at her funeral, as the person playing the music. You desire to play a playlist of funeral songs, then turn the music down low. Suddenly, mocking bird by Eminem starts playing mid speech. You try to skip it but you have reached your 6th skip. You try a different playlist, no luck. Big poppa is now playing in the background of widened mouths at the triggering thought of you taking this funeral un-seriously. (End)

There  should be an option to do tasks and get other free skips, including watching and ad, or do tasks, or change your profile, or something like that. However, your free skips do get replenished every hour, but it’s still not worth it if you are in this case.
